authority: Maintainer delegates all technical decisions for NF-102-03 through NF-102-06.
scope: Evaluate all four candidates; select and score only fully qualified candidates. A verified failed candidate remains failed, not repaired automatically or marked passed to equalize a scorecard.

rejected.reason: Native Windows canonicalization is incompatible with the selected AppContainer boundary. Retain actual CLI failures and exclude the candidate from selection; no DLL hook, filesystem authority exception or artificial successful benchmark.

Actual installed bootstrap returns NEXFLOW-PROTOTYPE-INTERNAL before discovery in the selected Windows boundary. Retain failed results and exclude this current prototype, without claiming a fundamental language limitation or successful timings.

remainingStatus: Require actual successful qualification on every supported target; this policy is not their pass evidence.
measurementDisposition: Collect comparable successful workloads for eligible candidates. Preserve all 84 original metric cells: failed/unsupported cells for a rejected candidate are not timings, scores, zero values or a claim of full four-candidate comparability.
taskClosureBoundary: Evidence/evaluation tasks may complete with an explicitly rejected candidate; no failed hard gate is promoted to pass. Original all-four-success/signing objectives are recorded separately from the amended eligible-candidate decision scope.
